rationale: Canonical OpenProcurement tender API docs — the machine-readable backbone for banking/payments tender collection.
Marketplace knowledge-base sub-page of prom.ua; methodology only, siblings covered by monitoring the parent marketplace.
Community awesome-list of Ukrainian open-data registries — mine once for snowballing leads, then archive.
AMCU statutory procurement-appeals section publishing reasoned decisions on contested tenders incl. banking equipment lots; failed verification is soft only.
Sub-page of the AMCU appeals section giving board composition and reports; adds little standalone signal.
One-off official notice defining where complaint decisions are published — useful pipeline-design evidence, not a recurring feed.
Prozorro central open API: the only CPV-filterable machine-readable route into tenders, awards and complaints.
Complaint schema page within the same readthedocs API docs already kept; needed for parsing but not a separate monitored source.
Public DASU procurement-monitoring dataset on data.gov.ua — structured context layer, updated periodically.
Unified court register: full-text judgments on procurement disputes naming bidders, specs and prices for ATM/POS/processing supply.
Daily-refreshed bulk dumps of the court register — scalable alternative to scraping the UI.
Opendatabot court/company API is valuable for automated litigation monitoring but registration/commercial licence must be cleared.
Commercial legal-analytics layer over court decisions; subscription gate needs human clearance before tracking.
DOZORRO curated digest of AMCU appeal decisions — durable, searchable entry point into the appeals corpus.
Dozorro risk-indicator tool is a useful prioritisation filter but reachability and access terms unverified.
Specialist procurement-practice publisher covering AMCU/DASU practice; standalone recurring commentary stream, some content may be gated.
HACC judgment portal exposing large-value state-bank and payments-infrastructure procurement corruption cases.
NABU press office names state-bank procurement schemes and amounts; public, ongoing signal stream.
Judiciary open-data hub with case-status and court datasets complementing full-text judgments.
